versions.changelog:
bilibili-content-summary v0.1.0 - Initial Release

- Extracts and summarizes Bilibili (B站) video and image-text content via audio download + ASR transcription / image OCR, uses LLM for summarization, and pushes results to Feishu.
- Supports interactive credential setup for B站, LLM/ASR/OCR models, and Feishu.
- Enforces strict agent rules: summary and Feishu push are always linked in one workflow.
- Provides detailed agent and human usage instructions; includes credential initialization, session authentication via QR code, and summary/push script commands.
- Summaries include a short abstract, key points, and chapter breakdowns.
- Robust directory structure and troubleshooting guidance for cookie/session expiration.
